venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 8/23 (MOD: KE, Chef: JMS; entered by BT)** Net sales $992 against a $1,339 target (74%). Food $64, comps $12.45 (1.25%); 26 guests at a $38.15 check average. (Report form was dated 8/24 but post time confirms it covers Sunday 8/23.) Much slower Sunday than usual — Charmers reported the same flow. No real pop, but a couple of small groups came in, one sent over by neighbors at Le Loup. Extra time went into reinforcing strong guest memories, including a short spirits tasting Kala ran for a visiting NC couple. Chef Danny held down the kitchen and got an end-of-night cocktail-knowledge session. Maintenance: CO2 issues remain. 86'd/low: very low Montenegro, more arriving Wednesday. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 8/23 (AM: MJH; PM: Carey)** Total net sales $10,587.63 against a $10,446 target (101%). DC/AM $1,073.56, D&C PM $9,514.07, Garden/6A $2,262.02; food $2,104.75; no events. Comps $506.20 (4.82%); 188 guests (Tock). AM was quiet — Felix did a deep cleanup on the back bar and fridge, a few IRDs from the wedding folks, cold brew made for tomorrow. PM was steady with strong guest interactions — lots of guests photographing the back bar, personalized recommendations, spirit and dessert pairings. Garden was chill but eventful with Mike Dees. Kitchen slow with a small 8pm pop; hood vents and spice shelves cleaned. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 8/23 (MOD: Thomas/Kyler)** Net sales $5,168 against a $3,546 target (146%). Beverage $4,852, food $275, retail $40; comps $102.30; 150 guests at a $34 check average. A dual-peaked night: solid open with a decent line at open, room full by 7:15, emptied by 8:30, then a strong 9:15 refill with controlled late-night date energy through close. 150 covers, 8 solos, 2 large parties, 3 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri, chips & dip. Kitchen note: snack-only menu cost tables — several explicitly wanted a meal and cut experiences short. No no-shows; not charged. Menu count 19.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sunday 8/23 (MOD: Joe + Josh + Oscar)** Net sales $4,370 against a $4,811 target (91%). Food $789, standing room $0; comps $165 (Bailey, Frank, Alfredo, investor, birthdays, anniversaries, DNL); 127 guests at a $71.64 reported check average. Solid Sunday: 40 covers on the books and a sleepy first hour, complicated by security not arriving until 8pm. Room filled by 7:30 with a small waitlist, several large-party walk-ins and industry at the bar top. Active through last call with a smooth finish; Jaz and Gracy crushed the floor. Favorite moment: Oscar's meatloaf. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Sunday 8/23 (MOD: Josh)** Net sales including events $2,198.53 against a $2,879 target (76%). Marquee bar $2,271.07, Garden closed; food $350; comps $72.54; 53 guests at a $41.48 GCA. Slow Sunday with a handful of reservations trickling in — smooth service left time to train the stage on service mechanics. Positive guest feedback on offerings, especially the Vipers. Kitchen back open (top sellers: fried chicken, tuna, popcorn, bread) and looking to rebuild food momentum. Maintenance: garbage disposal, point drink rail. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 8/23 (AM: Sam & Shannon; PM: Justin & Marcus)** Total net sales $6,771 against an $8,000 target (85%). Municipal Bar AM $1,691 (60 guests), PM $3,416 (64 guests), Sun Club $229, Hot Eye $1,436; food $2,376; comps $411; no events. Good steady Sunday morning with pops at 11 and 1. Evening happy hour and early dinner were busy before dying down by 7pm; cut to two servers, closed clean. New hire Maddie had her first host training shift. Hot Eye had a strong service-industry night — 9pm bar crawl on schedule, 10pm industry pop, Sundays becoming a locals' sanctuary. Kitchen: frisee still 86'd, mussels 86'd until tomorrow's truck. No incidents.
